katanas.name: Ikielas Katana
katanas.flavor: Her first blade — the one she carried when the city still felt safe.

katanas.name: Kurogane
katanas.flavor: Finely folded steel blade with no embellishments.

katanas.name: Mikazuki
katanas.flavor: Quenched under moonlight to harden the edge

katanas.name: Hayate

perk.description: Recharge time to slash again is cut in half

katanas.flavor: forged with wind-grooves along the spine, noticeably speeding up attack

katanas.name: Kagekiri

perk.description: On slash, turn into a shadow, teleport to the enemy in front, and cut their head off. Recharges in 15 seconds.

ui.note: Player chooses when to press. Does not fire automatically when recharged.

katanas.flavor: absorbs darkness, allowing strikes to at times become shadow.

katanas.name: Raikiri

perk.description: Calls lightning from the sky to strike your enemies, killing them instantly. Recharges in 25 seconds.

ui.note: Player chooses when to press. Does not fire automatically when recharged.

synergy.effect: When Storm Petal Cuirass is equipped, Call Lightning kills count as electrocuted and award double points.

katanas.flavor: crackles with kinetic charge... you best stand behind it..

katanas.name: Shin-En

perk.description: Red shadows kill all enemies on screen within 10 meters. Gain 15 health for each enemy killed this way. Recharges every 45 seconds.

ui.note: Player chooses when to press. Does not fire automatically when recharged.

katanas.flavor: their life is now yours. Your life is now its..

armors.name: Ikielas robes
armors.flavor: The robes she wore when the city was still peaceful.

armors.name: Mamushi Wrap
armors.flavor: a warrior of blade and spirit

armors.name: Gale-Dancer’s Kusazuri

perk.description: Cuts slash recharge time in half

armors.flavor: a swan is fast and free

armors.name: Storm Petal Cuirass

perk.description: Jumping over a target electrocutes them, giving a 25% chance to kill them. Double points for electrocuted enemies. Stacks with Raikiri: Call Lightning kills also count as electrocuted and get double points.

armors.flavor: trust in the currents of the wind and rains.

armors.name: Kitsune’s Mirage

perk.description: Turns you into shade for 30 meters. You cannot be hit by anything. Recharges after 20 seconds.

armors.flavor: an assasin lies in deception and trickery

armors.name: Shadow-Tread O-Yoroi

perk.description: +5 health per kill, cuts tickle damage by 25%, cuts slash attack recharge by half.

armors.flavor: heroism and death are not synonymous.

slashRecharge.name: Slash Speed
slashRecharge.description: Base slash recharge. Shop upgrades reduce recharge time. Hayate perk multiplies final recharge by 0.5.
interactionNotes: Final slash recharge = levels[level].rechargeSeconds * (0.5 if Hayate equipped else 1.0)
Player can slash once; then must wait rechargeSeconds before next slash.

techniques.name: Kunai Pouch
techniques.description: Throw a kunai that kills on hit. Capacity upgrades in Upgrades.

techniques.name: Horse Bow
techniques.description: Draw and fire an arrow that kills on hit. Bow recharge upgrades in Upgrades.

techniques.name: Flying Boost
techniques.description: Fireball boost dash forward — clears foes in the path. Recharges after use.

techniques.name: Shadow Strike
techniques.description: Turn into a shadow, teleport to the enemy in front, and cut them down. Recharges in 15 seconds. (Also granted by Kagekiri.)

techniques.name: Ethereal
techniques.description: Turn the player sprite purple and become unhittable for 30 meters. Recharges in 20 seconds. (Also granted by Kitsune's Mirage.)

upgrades.name: Slash Speed
upgrades.description: Reduce slash recharge. Base 1.5s, -0.2s per level x5. Costs 100,200,400,800,1600.

upgrades.name: Technique Power
upgrades.description: Shortens Flying Boost / Shadow Strike / Ethereal recharges by 10% per level.
